domain.operator_domain: smooth or distributional TT solutions on which constant-coefficient differential operators act
domain.parameters: M2=c1/alpha is nonzero; causal massive interpretation additionally assumes M2>0
domain.theory: source-free constant-compensator Einstein-Weyl TT equation unless the source audit is invoked

scope_guards: the algebraic identities hold on shell modulo Box(Box+M2)
support-nonincreasing locality applies to Pi_E and Pi_M on already-TT fields
no locality claim is made for the spatial TT reduction of a general metric perturbation
q=0 regularity of the branch projectors does not define a global helicity frame at zero momentum
a generic source splits into oppositely sourced branches and does not preserve Pi_M h=0
the M2->0 pure-Weyl limit is singular and retains the certified zero-pairing obstruction
no full BV, nonlinear, boundary, scattering, or quantum projector is claimed

source_audit.einstein_only_condition: Pi_M h=0 is compatible with the displayed scalar TT source equation only when J=0
source_audit.interpretation: the projectors split a sourced response but a generic source excites both branches; a sourced Einstein defect must be defined relative to the sourced Einstein equation

support_and_ir_audit.causal_consequence: the free solution splitting introduces no spacelike or future-boundary tail
support_and_ir_audit.existing_q_zero_exclusion: the prior helicity-wave-packet domain excludes k=0 because a global helicity frame and radiative polarization basis degenerate there, not because Pi_E or Pi_M is singular
support_and_ir_audit.pure_weyl_limit: M2->0 makes both projectors singular as the simple roots coalesce
support_and_ir_audit.q_zero: the projectors contain no inverse q or inverse |k| and are algebraically regular at q=0 for M2!=0
support_and_ir_audit.support_property: supp(Pi_E f) subset supp(f) and supp(Pi_M f) subset supp(f)

symplectic_projector_theorem.conclusion: the local branch splitting is the certified symplectic block decomposition

tt_locality_audit.consequence: this certificate cannot be promoted to a local projector on the unreduced metric BV complex
tt_locality_audit.local_statement: Pi_E and Pi_M are local differential operators on already-TT fields
tt_locality_audit.next_required_object: a gauge-covariant Einstein-defect subcomplex on the full Diff x Weyl BV fields, avoiding reliance on a nonlocal TT projection
tt_locality_audit.nonlocal_step_not_used: constructing a spatial TT representative from a general metric perturbation can require inverse elliptic operators
